basic_info.description: Discover the perfect blend of comfort, versatility & convenience in this charming home. The main level welcomes you w/ a bright & spacious living room that captures views of the surrounding neighborhood, flowing seamlessly into a formal dining room & a remodeled kitchen equipped w/ modern finishesperfect for everyday meals or entertaining. Two well-sized bedrooms & a full bathroom complete this level, offering comfort & functionality. The lower level provides even more flexibility w/ an expansive room currently staged as a 3rd bedroom, a full-sized bathroom & a bonus sunroom that brings in natural light & offers direct access to the backyard. Whether you need extra space for guests, a home office, or extended living, this level adapts to your lifestyle w/ ease. Adding to its appeal, the property features a 2-car side-by-side garage along w/ a 2-car driveway, offering the kind of parking & storage that is highly sought-after in Daly City. Situated in an amazing location, youll enjoy close proximity to local shops, restaurants, schools, and parks, as well as convenient access to BART and major freeways, making commutes to San Francisco, Silicon Valley & the Peninsula a breeze. This home truly combines comfort, modern updates & a prime location into one exceptional opportunity.
